metadata.title: PSASM
metadata.description: PSASM is a PowerShell-based 6502/6510 cross-assembler for Commodore 64 and other classic 8-bit systems, enabling developers to blend assembly with modern scripting power.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.
